# Remote Work Exception Policy

## Eligibility

Full-time employees in good standing may request a temporary remote-work
exception after 60 days of employment.

## Approval Requirements

Temporary remote-work exceptions require manager approval and HR approval.
Security awareness training must be current before access is extended outside
the office network.

## Equipment Stipend

Approved temporary remote-work exceptions may receive a one-time equipment
stipend of up to $300.
